scenarios.name: Attacking with two Zombies draws two, discards two and gains two life
scenarios.ruling: The trigger counts the attacking Zombies once; Varina is herself a Zombie, so attacking with her and another Zombie draws two, discards two and gains 2 life.

scenarios.name: Attacking with a creature that is not a Zombie does not trigger Varina
scenarios.ruling: The ability triggers only when you attack with one or more Zombies; a lone Grizzly Bears is not a Zombie.

scenarios.name: Varina exiles two cards from your graveyard to make a tapped Zombie token
scenarios.ruling: Exiling two cards from your graveyard is a cost, so the cards leave the graveyard for exile and a token is created.
